scientific_question: Does replacing positive-simplex atom routing by a signed activation-conditioned affine span recover the missing complete-expert MLP directions, while holding the four fixed complete atoms, learned gains, data, seeds, coordinate budget, and fit protocol fixed?

theory_reconciliation.new_measurement: The sealed positive-simplex candidate reaches only 0.372305/0.373528 heldout recovery, negative -0.250417/-0.251976 JVP recovery, and only +0.002394/+0.002363 over its identical static mixture. Router entropy remains near log(4), and cross-bank action cosine is only 0.732965.
theory_reconciliation.static_frontier: The strongest admissible static KFAC chart reaches 0.433036/0.426122, while the four complete FHT atoms reach about 0.37. Static capacity is real but insufficient; the simplex router does not add a useful direction.
theory_reconciliation.identified_restriction: Softmax coefficients are positive and sum to one. They can move only inside the convex hull of four fixed atom writes and cannot form the signed cancellations required to rotate a residual write beyond that hull. Its derivative is additionally mean-subtracted and small near the observed uniform solution.
theory_reconciliation.single_causal_change: Use an unbounded signed affine coefficient for each complete atom: a_m(x)=1/4+q_m+<w_m,phi(x)>/sqrt(8). This changes only coefficient geometry. The fixed complete atom functions, all channel gains, shared hidden bias, fixed signs, FHTs, and every optimizer/data choice are inherited unchanged.
theory_reconciliation.why_not_repeat_context_gate: The rejected context gate multiplied a linear c_fc map internally. The signed coefficient acts after each complete c_fc-GELU-c_proj residual function is formed, so it linearly spans whole nonlinear functions and can cancel complete residual writes.
theory_reconciliation.why_not_atom_or_seed_sweep: Atom count, fixed operator seed, router features, gains, LR, steps, and thresholds are identical to the sealed positive-simplex run. No dictionary-capacity or seed sweep is performed.
theory_reconciliation.mapping_connection: The compact learned state remains a smooth layer-wise latent modulation of fixed orthogonal procedural maps. Signed affine coordinates remove an unjustified simplex constraint while preserving the Mapping-Network requirement that no dense target or learned dense basis survives.

source.terminal_gauge: Use the exact terminal model, outer routing, dense complete-expert target, and frozen discovery/heldout banks used by the sealed positive-simplex candidate.

positive_simplex_result.finding: Positive-simplex activation routing adds only about 0.0024 recovery over the identical static mixture and has strongly negative JVP recovery.

maximum_budget_kfac_result.finding: The strongest stable static 200x chart reaches only 0.433036/0.426122 mean recovery.

candidate.name: signed_affine_four_complete_procedural_atoms
candidate.outer_router_scope: The source top-2 router is unchanged and independently counted. Every c_fc and c_proj matrix of all eight complete experts is removed.

same_run_control.name: static_signed_affine_four_atom_span
same_run_control.single_difference: Set the activation coefficient matrix W to zero and freeze it; fit the identical signed coefficient biases, gains, and shared hidden bias.
same_run_control.purpose: Isolate signed activation-dependent coefficients from the static signed linear span of the same complete atoms.

data_protocol.sampling: Reuse exact terminal outer routing and deterministic per-expert sampling. Candidate and static control receive identical discovery inputs, JVP probes, and targets.
data_protocol.anti_leakage: Fit discovery A and B independently. Heldout tokens and JVP probes never affect coordinates, stopping, initialization, thresholds, or candidate selection.

fit_protocol.optimizer: AdamW on all counted gains, shared hidden biases, coefficient biases, and eligible signed router weights
fit_protocol.objective: Equal-expert normalized residual-output MSE plus 0.10 normalized analytic input-JVP MSE.
fit_protocol.selection: Use the final registered step. No heldout selection, coefficient scale, normalization, seed, atom-count, router-width, LR, step, gain, threshold, or warm-start sweep.

evaluation.primary: Exact outer-routed dense-teacher residual-output recovery on untouched heldout activations.
evaluation.local: Analytic input-JVP recovery including the derivative of signed activation coefficients.
evaluation.expert: Score every source expert before outer top-2 mixture aggregation.
evaluation.stability: Compare heldout outer-routed actions from independently fitted discovery A/B candidates by cosine.
evaluation.causal: Compare candidate with the same-run static signed span and with the sealed positive-simplex candidate.

decision_rule.pass: Passing every gate in both banks authorizes only a production implementation/count/correctness phase and a separately preregistered initialization-plus-Mapping-Loss shadow. It does not authorize LM training directly.
decision_rule.fail: Reject the signed affine four-complete-atom family. Do not sweep coefficient scale/bound, atom count, atom seeds, router width, gains, LR, steps, regularization, or thresholds. Return to theory before another full-MLP candidate.
decision_rule.systems: Run an exact two-step GPU preflight. If projected or observed full runtime exceeds five minutes, use a verified terminal/error-only @Codex watcher launched through examples/nanogpt/launch_local_detached.py.
